description: #120 stretch 2 probe (owner hint: talk to a party member), generated by runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js from the touch layer; boots from touch-md1-1 (stretch 1's end, kept by touch-playthrough). Boots from touch-stall. Input: wait 1 frame. Metrics: a<axis><k>_<n>, the sign of |model k's PosX - Cloud's| (axis x) or |PosY - Cloud's| (axis y), in field units, minus n: model 3 at 256, 512, 1024, 2048. The checks may fail by design. Only signs, frame counts and small state values leave.
